sources.title: surogate/jackrabbit-110m-ro · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jackrabbit is Surogate's speech recognition family. This is the offline Romanian model: a 116M-parameter FastConformer with two decoders on one encoder, TDT and CTC, that writes cased, punctuated Romanian and runs comfortably on a CPU. For live audio use its sibling, Jackrabbit 110M Streaming.

sources.title: Surogate Speech: small open speech models for agents
sources.snippet: Our agents need to hear people and talk back, in whatever language those people speak. The models we tried misheard sums and dates, or needed a big GPU in someone else's cloud, so we started building our own: Surogate Speech, the speech side of Surogate. It holds a model family per job, Jackrabbit to listen and Amami to speak with more on the way, and each family ships language by language.
